calibration.note: Set 2026-10-31 from the weekly meter: 22% of the week used since the reset at 2026-10-30T20:00Z, against 246M units in every transcript since then (236M Opus). Recalibrate at each retro from a fresh meter reading.

weights.note: Starting values from list-price ratios (cache read 0.1x and cache write 1.25x of input, output 5x; opus 5/3 of sonnet, haiku 1/3, fable assumed equal to opus). Not measured against the weekly meter; a retro recalibrates them and says why.

unitTargetNote: Cost units, as the ledger computes them, summed over every turn of the agent. Starting values from fresh single-pass agents measured 2026-10-30/31 (a Sonnet fix round 1.1M, an Opus review 1.6M, a Sonnet builder of a 44-file PR 3.2M); a retro moves them. The ledger warns on an agent past its role target.

builder.note: opus only where the critical read names the step design-heavy

fix.note: always a fresh agent, at most 10 findings
